description: This file defines a Java record 'ApplyCouponResponse' used as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for the response from a coupon application API in the promotions service. It includes fields for coupon code, currency, discount amount, total before discount, and total after discount.

classes.name: ApplyCouponResponse
classes.description: A Java record that represents the response details for applying a coupon, including discount and total amounts.
